propositions: Six high-centrality, high-churn files sit within 7 lines of the 800-LOC module cap, with three at exactly 800 LOC, blocking ordinary feature work without structural refactoring
llm/config.py is the most central near-cap file (793 LOC, 7 lines headroom, 16 churn per 400 commits) and prevents d23e from landing a deprecation alias without preemptive relief
Absorbing verbs, flat declaration tables, and colocated domains must be extracted separately using shape-matched moves to permanently reduce future churn, not merely relocate mass
Per-function length gates are rejected; module-level seam tests asserting headroom targets are the substitute ratchet to prevent decomposed functions from regrowing
The plan-review step-registry membership and gates/plan-review.yaml resolution have no static assertion layer, leaving missed registrations currently uncatchable
